item.title: We Grew Up Thinking This Was Acceptable
item.description: We have grown up with this being acceptable. No wonder so many of us hated what we looked like or strived to look what society deemed as acceptable. I pray and hope this is changing for us and our children. No one has the right to comment on your body and weight. Period.
